patch.summary: IPRoyal cost guide: researched plan structure, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: IPRoyal pricing is plan-gated across 3 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.heading: IPRoyal cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price IPRoyal against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; No free/trial flag confirmed in SG data — budget a paid pilot.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (CI/CD and automation, proxy / web data network) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Does not outrank Bright Data (7.7). Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Teams that need a low published residential GB floor requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Brand maturity and enterprise compliance story are thinner than Bright Data / Oxylabs

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: list price/GB is metered — never-expires unused traffic is not unlimited scrape throughput

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Not a managed scraping API (Zyte / ScraperAPI) or Actor platform (Apify)

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not ITSM, observability, git, hosting panel, or managed hosting

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs IPRoyal on identical constraints.
